mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand persons) combined with a weak housing market (HOUST < 1,200 thousand units) signals economic cooling, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000 and HOUST < 1200, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars) signal robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 500000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand persons and UNRATE < 3.5%) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
